title: Share pickup details only after confirmation
context: Neighbors need to find nearby items without making their address public.
decision: Public listings show a neighborhood. Only the owner and confirmed borrower can see the exact pickup location and contact details.

alternatives.name: Show the address on every listing
alternatives.reason: Rejected: exposes private location details to anyone browsing.

alternatives.name: Require a separate chat for every pickup
alternatives.reason: Rejected: adds unnecessary work when both members have already agreed.
